title: Strongly measurable first-hit selection along measurable sets
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let A_k ⊆ ℝ^P (k ∈ ℕ) be Borel-measurable sets, and let (b_k)_{k∈ℕ} be a sequence in Λ^n = Covector (Euclid P) n. Then there is a strongly measurable g : ℝ^P → Λ^n such that for every x ∈ ℝ^P either g(x) = 0 and x ∉ A_k for every k, or there is k with x ∈ A_k and g(x) = b_k.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (b : ℕ → Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (A k)) → ∃ g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, StronglyMeasurable g ∧ ∀ x, (g x = 0 ∧ ∀ k, x ∉ A k) ∨ ∃ k, x ∈ A k ∧ g x = b k
